facts.raw_span: severe cardiogenic shock with multiorgan failure of unknown cause
recurrent hypertensive episodes
profound hypotension and pulmonary oedema
severely impaired left ventricular (LV) systolic function
no evidence of relevant coronary artery disease
toxicological screening was negative
chronic polyarthritis and treated arterial hypertension
invasively ventilated (PaO2/FiO2 30 mmHg)
norepinephrine at 2.5 µg/kg/min
pulseless electrical activity requiring 5 minutes of resuscitation
akinesia of all basal and mid LV segments with preserved apical contraction (left ventricular ejection fraction, 15%)
moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling

concepts.why: severely impaired left ventricular systolic function and akinesia of all basal and mid LV segments with preserved apical contraction
moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling
recurrent hypertensive episodes and treated arterial hypertension
severe cardiogenic shock with multiorgan failure of unknown cause

It explains the uncovered finding of severely impaired left ventricular systolic function without evidence of relevant coronary artery disease and pulseless electrical activity.

rationales.F01: Severe cardiogenic shock with multiorgan failure suggests a strong rule-in for cardiogenic shock.
rationales.F04: Severely impaired left ventricular systolic function is a key feature of cardiogenic shock and myocarditis.
rationales.F05: No evidence of relevant coronary artery disease rules out acute coronary syndrome.
rationales.F06: Negative toxicological screening rules out toxic cardiomyopathy.
rationales.F11: Akinesia of all basal and mid LV segments with preserved apical contraction is characteristic of reverse takotsubo cardiomyopathy.
rationales.F12: Moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling is a strong rule-in for myocarditis.

frontier_selector.rationale: The patient's endomyocardial biopsy revealed moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling, which directly explains the severely impaired left ventricular function and cardiogenic shock.
